'''Liz Ryder''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Demolition Unlimited''' in the '''Eurybia''' system. A demolitions expert associated with the Eurybia Blue Mafia, she specialises in explosive weapons and is one of the independent entry points into ship [[Engineering]].<ref name="edwiki-liz">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Liz_Ryder Liz Ryder], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Liz provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Missile Rack|Missile Racks]], [[Seeker Missile Rack|Seeker Missile Racks]], and [[Torpedo Pylon|Torpedo Pylons]]. Her [[Mine Launcher]] services reach Grade 3, while [[Armour]] and [[Hull Reinforcement Package]] services reach Grade 1.<ref name="inara-liz">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/5/ Liz Ryder — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Eurybia
* '''Body:''' Makalu
* '''Facility:''' Demolition Unlimited
* '''Engineer scope:''' Explosive weapons, mining tools, and basic hull protection
* '''Referral required:''' None
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Liz Ryder's whereabouts are public knowledge, so no referral from another Engineer is required. Access has two further conditions:<ref name="inara-liz" /><ref name="edwiki-liz" />

# Reach at least '''Cordial''' reputation with the '''Eurybia Blue Mafia'''.
# Provide '''200 units of [[Landmines]]''' at Demolition Unlimited.

Minor-faction reputation and Engineer reputation are separate systems. The complete ordered process, including reputation building, cargo sourcing, and delivery, belongs to [[Unlocking Liz Ryder]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Liz Ryder increases by:<ref name="inara-liz" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling commodities at Demolition Unlimited.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Liz supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-liz" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add the following Operations-era services to Liz's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-liz" />

* '''Far-reaching''' [[Abrasion Blaster]] engineering through Grade 3
* '''High-yield''' Enzyme Missile Rack engineering through Grade 3
* '''Long Range''' [[Mining Laser]] engineering through Grade 3
* '''Drag''', '''Exposing''', '''Lightweight Thermal''', and '''Lockdown''' [[Seeker Missile Rack]] engineering through Grade 5

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Liz Ryder blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Liz Ryder directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with her:

* '''[[Hera Tani]]'''<ref name="inara-hera">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/12/ Hera Tani — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Etienne Dorn]]''' in the Colonia region<ref name="inara-dorn">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/23/ Etienne Dorn — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own meeting or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
